name: Deployer
description: The Deployer is a mechanical player hand.

pages.title: Deployer
pages.text: The **Deployer** is a mechanical player hand. Given rotation, it does what you do: place blocks, use items, activate blocks, harvest and attack mobs. It acts on the position two blocks in front of it.

pages.title: Deployer
pages.text: Right-click its front to give it an item. A [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() switches between right-click and left-click mode.

In automation it **applies items to other items**. Held item over a [#](2E5AAC)[belt or depot](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]() item: the combination is an [#](2E5AAC)[assembly step](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#](). This is how a machine adds cogwheels, [sand paper](item://create:sand_paper) or ingredients.\
\
It also feeds [#](2E5AAC)[Blaze Burners](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() fuel.

A negative redstone pulse triggers one cycle. On a [#](2E5AAC)[contraption](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#](), deployers act at every place they pass, pulling from storage on the machine.\
\
The same trick builds [#](2E5AAC)[precision mechanisms](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#]() by looping a deployer, press and more.
